name: tanstack-solid-config
title: TanStack SolidJS Tailwind Application Config
description: A base config files for a tanstack, solidjs, tailwindcss application

files.content:
repos:
  - repo: https://github.com/zricethezav/gitleaks
    rev: v8.18.4
    hooks:
      - id: gitleaks
  - repo: local
    hooks:
      - id: pnpm-checks
        name: Format, Lint, Type Check, and Tests
        entry: sh -c 'pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm compile && pnpm test:coverage'
        language: system
        pass_filenames: false

import gcPrettierTailwindApp from "@getcommunity/config-prettier/app-tailwind.js"

export default gcPrettierTailwindApp
